# Purpose
This generated header defines the metric layout for `gossvf` traffic in the metrics system. It declares counter names, storage offsets, types, and field counts for message receive totals and CRDS receive totals, with separate entries for success cases and drop reasons. The macros map each metric and submetric to a fixed position in the `FD_METRICS_GOSSVF` metadata array, which lets the codebase record and read these values in a consistent way. The file also includes the base metrics headers and exposes the `FD_METRICS_GOSSVF` table for use by other source files.
